name: Manage reservations
description: Validates and saves one reservation action (check/create/reschedule/cancel/list) for the CS agent. Keeps booking rules deterministic so the LLM only collects details; returns {ok, action, message, data}.

nodes.name: Load Settings
nodes.notes: Business hours, slot size, capacity and admin chat from Automation Settings.

nodes.name: Load Services
nodes.notes: All services; inactive ones are filtered in the Code node.

nodes.name: Load Reservations
nodes.notes: All reservations (small volume). alwaysOutputData so an empty table still reaches the decision.

nodes.name: Decide reservation outcome
nodes.notes: Why Code: overlap/capacity math + many business rules in one place; returns {ok,message,data,write}.

nodes.name: Notify admin of change
nodes.notes: Best-effort: a failed admin ping must not undo a saved booking.

nodes.name: Update reservation
nodes.notes: Matches on bookingCode AND customerId so a customer can only touch their own booking.

nodeGroups.name: Load data
nodeGroups.description: Reads settings, services and all reservations once per call.

nodeGroups.name: Save and reply
nodeGroups.description: Writes at most one row, pings the admin, returns {ok, message, data} to the agent.

versionMetadata.name: Use Telegram CS Bot credential for admin notices
versionMetadata.description: Admin notifications now use the dedicated CS bot credential instead of the morning briefing bot.
